audit.whatIsWrong: Rated HARD, difficulty 7/10, on a lane Nasus wins 53.85% over 247 games — and the entry's own level chart gives Nasus three stages, Heimerdinger three, one skill.
audit.why: A winning matchup labelled HARD 7/10 tells the player to play scared through a lane whose only real problem is a three-level zoning window. The chart, the win rate and the prose all describe an even-to-favoured lane.
audit.corrected: diff EVEN, diffRating 5/10, breakdown.difficulty and the final rating line brought in line.

audit.whatIsWrong: Defect list: 'never names any of Heimerdinger's abilities'. The content layer said only 'turrets', 'W rockets', 'E grenade stun', 'R-turrets'.
audit.why: Vague labels stop the player recognising what is on screen. The real names are H-28 G Evolution Turret, Hextech Micro-Rockets, CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade, UPGRADE!!! and Hextech Affinity.
audit.corrected: Named across early, mid, whys[2], whys[4], spikes[0] and both wants.foe entries.

audit.whatIsWrong: The grenade is described as a flat 'stun' the player must never eat, with no mention that the stun is conditional.
audit.why: Riot's text: 'stunning anyone directly hit and slowing surrounding units.' Only a direct hit stuns; the outer radius is a slow. For a melee champion who has to cross that radius to reach the wave, the difference between 'walk in and get stunned' and 'clip the edge and get slowed' is the whole decision.
audit.corrected: Direct-hit condition stated in breakdown.cooldowns, dontsFull and the early-game text.

audit.whatIsWrong: Defect list: 'NO cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere'. breakdown.cooldowns carried no numbers at all.
audit.why: CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade is a flat 11 seconds at every rank — it does not shorten as he levels it. That makes it the most countable window in the lane: once it is spent, the next eleven seconds are free walking time for a champion with a 700-range slow.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns now carries the flat 11s and the direct-hit condition.

audit.whatIsWrong: Hextech Affinity is never mentioned anywhere, and dosFull[2] 'Clear his turrets to farm' carried an unrelated boilerplate description.
audit.why: Hextech Affinity grants move speed only while he is near allied towers and his own deployed turrets. That is the entire reason he outruns Nasus inside the nest and nowhere else — clearing turrets removes his kite, which is exactly what the do's title is claiming.
audit.corrected: dosFull[2].d now explains why clearing turrets is what makes Wither stick.

audit.why: breakdown.cooldowns' second line names 'CH-3X Lightning Grenade'. Checked: that is the genuine UPGRADE!!! version of CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade, not an invented name. Kept, and tied explicitly to UPGRADE!!! so the player knows when it appears.

audit.whatIsWrong: full phases[6] '2+ items' is side 'Skill' while its own why says 'you out-duel Heimerdinger on cooldown and three-shot his tower', and content win[6] is 'Nasus'.
audit.why: Heimerdinger has no dash, no blink and no escape; a Nasus with stacks, Wither and Fury of the Sands is not in a skill-matchup with him at two items. Both the stage text and the content layer already say so.

edits.before: Overall difficulty: 7/10. The lane is decided by how well you track CH-2 Grenade (Stun) and how disciplined your pattern is.
edits.after: Overall difficulty: 5/10. The lane is decided by how well you track CH-2 Grenade (Stun) and how disciplined your pattern is.

edits.before: Hard matchup — difficulty 7/10, Heimerdinger carry threat 8/10.
edits.after: Even matchup — difficulty 5/10, Heimerdinger carry threat 8/10.

edits.before: - Heimerdinger CH-2 Grenade (Stun): matchup-defining — His self-peel stun. Dodge it. Track it before every engage. - Heimerdinger CH-3X Lightning Grenade: Lobs a grenade that slows, and stuns at the center. Dodge or sidestep it.
edits.after: - Heimerdinger CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade: matchup-defining — a flat 11s at every rank, and it only stuns on a direct hit; clip the edge and you are merely slowed. - Heimerdinger CH-3X Lightning Grenade: the UPGRADE!!! version. Same rule.

edits.before: E lets you stack safely from range when Heimerdinger zones you. Spirit Fire the wave under tower; every stack denied is his only real win condition.
edits.after: Spirit Fire the wave from 650 range instead of walking the turret line; every stack you bank behind H-28 G Evolution Turret is one he cannot deny you.

edits.before: Burning your answer for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: It only stuns on a direct hit — clip the edge and you are merely slowed.

edits.before: Heimerdinger wastes CH-2 Grenade (Stun) — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Hextech Affinity only speeds him near his own turrets — kill them and he cannot kite.

edits.before: Level 1 you just soak Q farm — Heimer can't fight a melee at point-blank yet and you out-sustain his early chip with Soul Eater lifesteal. The problem starts once his turrets are up: they wall the minions and his W rockets poke you every time you reach for a Q stack. Do NOT walk through the turret line to last-hit — eat the missed stack rather than the E grenade stun, which is the only thing that lets him or a jungler kill you here.
edits.after: Level 1 you just soak Q farm — Heimer can't fight a melee at point-blank yet and you out-sustain his early chip with Soul Eater lifesteal. The problem starts once H-28 G Evolution Turret is down: turrets wall the minions and Hextech Micro-Rockets poke you every time you reach for a Q stack. Do NOT walk the turret line to last-hit — eat the missed stack rather than a direct CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade, which is what gets you killed here.

edits.before: Levels 4-6 are his window, not yours — three turrets plus rockets out-zone you, and even your level 6 Fury of the Sands only buys you survival, not a kill, because his upgraded R-turrets still shred you in the field. Wither his escape if he ever steps up alone, but don't dive the turret nest. Farm stacks at the safe edge of the wave with Spirit Fire, soak the lane XP, and play for the items that flip this.
edits.after: Levels 4-6 are his window, not yours — three turrets plus Hextech Micro-Rockets out-zone you, and even your level 6 Fury of the Sands only buys survival, not a kill, because an UPGRADE!!! turret still shreds you in the field. Wither him the moment he steps up alone; he has no dash and no blink, so the slow is a death sentence. Otherwise farm stacks at the safe edge with Spirit Fire and play for the items that flip this.

edits.before: His turret wall plus W rockets zone you off the wave and his E grenade stun chunks you — he owns the stack-denial window now.
edits.after: H-28 G Evolution Turret walls the wave and Hextech Micro-Rockets tax every stack you reach for — his stack-denial window.

edits.before: Fury of the Sands only buys survival here — his upgraded R-turrets still out-zone you, so respect the all-in instead of diving.
edits.after: Fury of the Sands only buys survival here — an UPGRADE!!! turret still out-zones you, so respect the nest instead of diving it.

edits.before: Heimer's turret wall plus E grenade stun and W rockets zone you off the wave — this is his strongest window and where he tries to deny your stacks.
edits.after: His turret wall plus CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade and Hextech Micro-Rockets zone you off the wave — his strongest window and his stack-denial plan.

edits.before: Wall the minions with turrets and W-rocket poke you off every Q stack
edits.after: Wall the minions with H-28 G Evolution Turret and rocket you off each stack

edits.before: Land the E grenade stun to chunk you or set up a gank when you walk up
edits.after: Land CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade square on you to chunk or set up a gank

notes: Heimerdinger's turrets take reduced damage from area-of-effect abilities in some versions of the game — if true that would matter a lot for whether Spirit Fire is a real turret-clearing tool. I could not confirm it from the kit file and did not assert it either way, so no text claims Spirit Fire clears the nest.
